hypotheses.title: Increasing Repulsion Gain for Improved Obstacle Avoidance
hypotheses.statement: Increasing the repulsion gain will make the robot more responsive to obstacles, leading to better obstacle clearance.
hypotheses.mechanism: The repulsion gain determines how strongly the robot reacts to obstacles in its path, influencing its ability to navigate around them.

hypotheses.title: Reducing Safety Margin for Enhanced Speed
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to travel closer to obstacles, potentially increasing its speed and efficiency in obstacle clearance.
hypotheses.mechanism: The safety margin is the buffer distance the robot maintains from obstacles to ensure safe navigation. Reducing this margin can increase the robot's speed but may also increase the risk of collisions.
